# Cuesoft Privacy Policy

> What each Cuesoft website collects, why, and your rights over it.

This policy is issued by Cuesoft Inc. and Cuesoft Nigeria Limited, who act as
joint data controllers for the Cuesoft websites, under Nigerian, EU/UK and
US law. It covers what each website collects, how the data is handled
(processors, international transfers, retention, security and breach
notification), your rights and how to exercise them, and children. Cueprise(TM)
has its own privacy notice. The websites take no payments and Cuesoft does not
sell personal data.

## About Cuesoft

Cuesoft is an AI company that builds its own engineers. It has been building
software since 2017, and is incorporated as Cuesoft Inc. in Dover, Delaware and
as Cuesoft Nigeria Limited in Ikoyi, Lagos. It works with clients in Nigeria and
the United States.

Three divisions, in sequence: CueTA(TM) trains engineers on live AI work,
CueLABS(TM) proves them in public on open-source products, and CueHIRE(TM),
Cuesoft's talent and project management agency, delivers them to companies
through end-to-end delivery, managed engineers and referral hiring. Two
products: Cueprise(TM), a business management system licensed per business and
deployed on the client's own cloud, and Storefront(TM), the website a business
puts in front of its customers.
